name: What exactly counts as bathroom waterproofing, and is tile or grout enough by itself?

mainEntity.name: What exactly counts as bathroom waterproofing, and is tile or grout enough by itself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom waterproofing should be treated as a full system, not just a coating under the tile. In a shower, the membrane, drain, corners, niches, curb, and penetrations all need to be coordinated so water cannot reach the framing or subfloor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile and grout are not waterproofing. The waterproofing system is the membrane and detailing behind or under the tile, especially at corners, drains, and penetrations.
